title: Method for selecting local entities for federated learning training

pse.problem: The patent describes a limitation in network data analytics function (NWDAF) for 5G systems. It requires initial training of artificial intelligence and machine learning models, which is a complicated task with continuous need to improve the quality of training data.
pse.solution_function: The invention uses federated learning, where distributed local entities collaboratively train a global machine learning model using their local data. The central entity aggregates the results from each iteration, updates the global model, and sends it back to the local entities.
pse.solution_structure: The system consists of a service consumer, network function, and multiple local entities. The service consumer requests federated learning training support from the network function, which selects a heterogeneous group of local entities for training. Each local entity receives an instance of a machine learning model to train.
pse.solution_implementation: In each iteration, local entities train their instances based on the global model received from the central entity and send updates back. The central entity aggregates the results and updates the global model accordingly. This process continues until satisfactory training is achieved.
pse.effect: The solution provides a way to train machine learning models using distributed data while maintaining privacy, allowing for continuous improvement of the model's performance and accuracy.
